description: PyGeoHydro is Taher Chegini and the HyRiver community's Python package for retrieving geospatial hydrology information from public services. It supports streamflow, water quality, dams, land cover, soil properties, flood layers and related products through documented query functions. Inputs are station identifiers, geometries, coordinates, dates or product selections; outputs include tabular, labelled-array and geospatial objects for analysis. Coverage is mainly United States services, with some global products such as SoilGrids. Source is free under MIT, while each upstream dataset retains its own terms. A limitation is that service changes, availability and differing spatial resolutions affect reproducibility; the software does not verify every retrieved observation. PyGeoHydro can prepare and check data for water and flood infrastructure simulations. Wflow (model-wflow) is related modelling context. The repository distinguishes this package from the other HyRiver modules and cites the shared software paper. No service data were downloaded.
